notes.title: Endless and Settings Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]v1.4.1[/h2]

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Prevent broken gameplay when playing from a saved endless game

[h2]v1.4.0[/h2]

[b]Added[/b]
- Save endless progress
- Delete save file from settings menu

[b]Changed[/b]
- New settings menu

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Leaderboard crash when opened without a submitted score
- Multiple highlighted items on the leaderboard
